content:
Binary output issue
* According to the contribution guidelines, binary outputs should be avoided for clashes. That's exactly the issue with your clash, as it allows only two possible answers (either True or False). Please modify the output requirement to allow for more than two possible answers.

Theme
* There are already a number of clashes on the theme of Pythagorean triples:

https://www.codingame.com/contribute/view/110466dd06742c57f25dc0b2297a785e4047e2
https://www.codingame.com/contribute/view/35721ab9991a467ca482862b180b27aea0b12
https://www.codingame.com/contribute/view/236430182b5b60170705e8fc19ae222e00769
https://www.codingame.com/contribute/view/7667c5817cc7b06a1f3eb6b2a045c85a0587
https://www.codingame.com/contribute/view/9719a4c2a627fcaef585053f8400b8a8502
https://www.codingame.com/contribute/view/7171fa00c9585c9628e4e1bfc7f97f34140

If you want to continue with this theme, please make your contribution unique; otherwise, please use another theme for your contribution.

Stub generator
* Please revise Line 1 to parse three integers instead of a single string.

Cases
* These cases are the same:
  • Example (Test 1) / Validator 1
  • Not a triangle (Test 5) / Validator 5

  Please make sure all cases are different while each test and its validator should cover the same scenario with slightly different inputs (and outputs if applicable).

Thanks.
